        <transactionPurpose>Item 4 of the Schedule 13D is hereby amended and supplemented by adding the following: The sales of Common Stock reported in Item 5(c) of this Amendment No. 5 were effected in connection with the Reporting Person's margin account with J.P. Morgan described in Item 6, in order to maintain such account in a non-margin position, and not as a result of any change in the Reporting Person's view of the Issuer. The Reporting Person may from time to time dispose of shares of Common Stock, including in order to maintain such margin account in a non-margin position, or acquire additional shares of Common Stock, in each case in the open market, in privately negotiated transactions or otherwise, depending on market conditions, the price of the Common Stock, the requirements of such margin account and other factors. The Reporting Person intends to communicate with the Issuer's management and Board of Directors regarding exiting the power business. Except as set forth herein, the Reporting Person does not have any present plans or proposals that relate to or would result in any of the matters set forth in clauses (a) through (j) of Item 4 of Schedule 13D, although the Reporting Person reserves the right to develop such plans or proposals and to change his intentions with respect to any of the matters described herein at any time.</transactionPurpose>

      <item6>
        <contractDescription>Item 6 of the Schedule 13D is hereby amended and supplemented by adding the following: The Reporting Person maintains a margin account with J.P. Morgan ("JPM") pursuant to a margin agreement (the "Margin Agreement"). The Reporting Person intends to maintain such account in a non-margin position, and the sales reported in Item 5(c) were effected for that purpose. Upon the occurrence of a default or a margin deficiency under the Margin Agreement, JPM may sell shares of Common Stock held in such account. There have been no changes to the Agreement with UBS described in this Item 6, and no tranche thereunder has been settled early, accelerated or amended, and the Pledged Shares remain pledged thereunder. Except as described in this Schedule 13D, the Reporting Person is not party to any contracts, arrangements, understandings or relationships (legal or otherwise) with any person with respect to any securities of the Issuer.</contractDescription>
